description: This file defines the SiloOptionsLogger class, which extends OptionsLogger and implements ILifecycleParticipant for ISiloLifecycle. It provides logging functionality for silo options during the lifecycle of an Orleans silo.

classes.name: SiloOptionsLogger
classes.description: A logger class for silo options that participates in the silo lifecycle to log options at startup.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the logger to the silo lifecycle to invoke OnStart during the first stage.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Logs the silo options when the silo lifecycle reaches the start stage.
